What is Bathtub Refinishing? Bathtub Refinishing is a process where the enamel on the bathtub is worn, discolored or a color that is out-of-date is restored to a newer easier to clean finish. This method, as explained later below, can be done on all types of surfaces. Porcelain, steel, fiberglass, acrylic, cultured marble, Vikrell and plastic mobile home tubs can be refinished.

  1. Our first step is to remove the caulking/silicone & surface debris from the fixture.

  2. Any coating from a previous restoration is stripped chemically.

  3. We use a 2 step cleaning process before applying the chemical bond and finish topcoat. A damage inspection is done

  4. Any remaining moisture is allowed to dry and all surface repairs are made.

  5. After allowing the surface to dry and repairs are made we mask off the perimeter of the area to be resurfaced by using the proper masking material for delicate or normal surfaces and drop cloths to protect the surrounding areas. We only want spray on your surface to be refinished, nothing else.

  6. Once masking and drops are laid we chemical neutralize the surface.

  7. Once this step is completed we set up the ventilation equipment to extract over spray and fumes from the items to be refinished.

  8. Next, our chemical bond coupling agent is applied. Our bonding agent is applied to a properly neutralized substrate which creates a permanent molecular bond with the top coat, making it impossible for moisture to penetrate between the new glaze and original surface. This bonding agent was field tested, developed and manufactured specifically to apply our high solids aliphatic urethane glaze directly to the surface without needing to etch or sand. This system provides a premium high gloss close to factory finish. Our bonding agent works on all hard resilient surfaces whether it’s glass, porcelain, gel coat, acrylic, cultured marble, plastic or laminate.

  9. Next a high gloss aliphatic urethane top coat is applied using an HVLP turbine spray system. Our top coat is an un-cut and un-modified true high solids gloss urethane. It has incredible flexibility, excellent adhesion, superior gloss retention and is UV, chemical and graffiti resistant. Our process produces an unmatched deep gloss and does not require cutting and buffing once the finish is cured.

  10. Check the new surface for minor dust bumps or debris and polish if needed and return any plumbing trim removed prior to refinishing.

  11. Most importantly - USE PROTECTION for your eyes / skin, as well as lung protection. Most of the chemicals used are highly toxic!
